entities.summary: Amdo, also known as Domey, is one of the three traditional Tibetan regions. It encompasses a large area from the Machu to the Drichu (Yangtze). Amdo is mostly coterminous with China's present-day Qinghai province, but also includes small portions of Sichuan and Gansu provinces.
